description: This file defines a class 'Emitter' used for generating and writing formatted text or code to a file, with support for indentation, line wrapping, and buffering.

classes.name: Emitter
classes.description: A class responsible for emitting formatted text to a file, managing indentation, line wrapping, and buffering.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the emitter with a target filename and indentation size.

methods.name: __del__
methods.description: Destructor that flushes remaining lines and closes the file if open.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables use of the emitter as a context manager.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Handles cleanup when exiting the context manager (no specific action here).

methods.name: Line
methods.description: Adds a line of text to the buffer, with optional line wrapping based on a threshold.

methods.name: Unindent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level, ensuring it does not go below zero.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends lines from another emitter object to this emitter's buffer.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends lines from another emitter object to this emitter's buffer.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Returns the name of the file associated with the emitter, if any.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Writes all buffered lines to the file and ensures the file is properly written.
